hints.tr: İki kırılım için gruplama listesi kullanılıyor: `groupby(["team", "level"])`.
İki etiketli bir sonuçtan tek değer almak için `detay[("A", "hard")]` yazılıyor. Soruların dağılımını `crosstab` ya da `groupby([...]).size()` veriyor.
hints.en: To read one value out of a two-label result you write `detail[("A", "hard")]`. The question mix comes from `crosstab` or `groupby([...]).size()`.

hints.tr:
Çözüm:

```python
genel = records.groupby("team")["score"].mean()
detay = records.groupby(["team", "level"])["score"].mean()
zor = records[records["level"] == "hard"]["team"].value_counts()

print(genel["A"], genel["B"])
print(genel.idxmax())
print(zor["A"], zor["B"])
print(detay[("A", "easy")], detay[("B", "easy")])
print(detay[("A", "hard")], detay[("B", "hard")])
```
hints.en:
The solution:

```python
overall = records.groupby("team")["score"].mean()
detail = records.groupby(["team", "level"])["score"].mean()
hard = records[records["level"] == "hard"]["team"].value_counts()

print(overall["A"], overall["B"])
print(overall.idxmax())
print(hard["A"], hard["B"])
print(detail[("A", "easy")], detail[("B", "easy")])
print(detail[("A", "hard")], detail[("B", "hard")])
```
